findings.claim: Unsubscribe by guessable integer id is unauthenticated; any user can be unsubscribed by a third party.
User email addresses and search params are written to console logs and Sentry breadcrumbs, leaking PII into third-party log storage.
The alert history query filters notifications by user_id and sent_at with no index; at 2k saved searches the table grows by thousands of rows a day.
findings.evidence: No new indexes — the table starts empty
findings.recommendation: create index on notifications (user_id, sent_at desc).

findings.claim: The cap of 10 active saved searches is enforced only in the route handler, not with a database constraint.
findings.evidence: Cap at 10 active saved searches per user.
findings.recommendation: Add a trigger or check in a transaction.
